caption: The drawing depicts a large pair of tailor’s scissors rendered in shades of dark gray and brown, positioned horizontally, with the tips of the blades pointed to the right. The scissors have two oval-shaped handles at the left end, connected by a central pivot. The blades are elongated and pointed, and the upper blade is labeled with the words “ROCH THE” while the lower blade reads “TAILOR,” all in uppercase black letters. Both blades of the scissors are attached vertically to a narrow, horizontal wooden plank below them by two straight rods, one near the handles and one near the tips. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects present in the image.
title: Shop Sign
